sloka: तम् वर्धयित्वा राजानम् सूतः पूर्वम् जयाशिषा।भयविक्लबया वाचा मन्दया श्लक्ष्णमब्रवीत् ॥२-३४-५॥
transliteration: tam vardhayitvā rājānam sūtaḥ pūrvam jayāśiṣā।bhayaviklabayā vācā mandayā ślakṣṇamabravīt ॥2-34-5॥

translations.english: At first greeting the king with the words 'victory be yours', the charioteer, trembling with fear, gently said in a feeble voice.
